## Official delta summary

- 34 non-merge official commits.
- 168 changed files: 25 added and 143 modified.
- Primary changes: ChatGPT Live gateway support, Claude Opus 5 support,
  request-driven Ollama Cloud usage refresh, persisted client session IDs,
  announcement preview and rich-text fixes, and registration email-alias
  deduplication.
- The official dependency changes are retained together with the existing
  custom PostCSS hardening: direct `postcss` remains `^8.5.23`, while the new
  official `postcss@<8.5.18` override is also present.

The backend merge retains the thin custom moderation bridge while adding the

resolved by preserving both PostCSS constraints and regenerating with pnpm

## Database gate

Database semantics changed. The normalized exact-candidate fingerprint is:

- Fingerprint:
  `dd91f790808b152564fa3ae6c9aa422d95f60b14f637e7a442aba77ec19d6d32`
- `backend/migrations/187_add_usage_log_session_id.sql`
  adds nullable `VARCHAR(255)` columns to `usage_logs` and
  `batch_image_jobs`.
- `backend/migrations/188_allow_live_usage_request_type.sql`
  replaces `usage_logs_request_type_check` with the inclusive range `0–5`.
- `backend/migrations/189_add_group_allow_live.sql`
  adds `groups.allow_live BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false`.
- `backend/migrations/190_add_users_email_alias_dedup_index_notx.sql`
  creates `idx_users_email_dot_stripped` concurrently and outside a
  transaction.

The first three migrations are transactional. The concurrent index migration
uses the official `_notx.sql` execution path and `IF NOT EXISTS`. A failed
concurrent build can leave an invalid index, so the read-only checks below
must confirm `indisvalid=true` and `indisready=true` before deployment is
accepted. No production SQL was executed.

### Production read-only checks

```sql
SELECT filename, checksum
FROM schema_migrations
WHERE filename IN (
  '187_add_usage_log_session_id.sql',
  '188_allow_live_usage_request_type.sql',
  '189_add_group_allow_live.sql',
  '190_add_users_email_alias_dedup_index_notx.sql'
)
ORDER BY filename;

SELECT table_name, column_name, data_type, character_maximum_length,
       is_nullable, column_default
FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE (table_name, column_name) IN (
  ('usage_logs', 'session_id'),
  ('batch_image_jobs', 'session_id'),
  ('groups', 'allow_live')
)
ORDER BY table_name, column_name;

SELECT conname, pg_get_constraintdef(oid)
FROM pg_constraint
WHERE conrelid = 'usage_logs'::regclass
  AND conname = 'usage_logs_request_type_check';

SELECT c.relname AS index_name, i.indisvalid, i.indisready,
       pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid) AS index_definition
FROM pg_index i
JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = i.indexrelid
WHERE c.relname = 'idx_users_email_dot_stripped';

SELECT request_type, COUNT(*)
FROM usage_logs
WHERE request_type < 0 OR request_type > 5
GROUP BY request_type
ORDER BY request_type;
```

### Forward migration SQL

The application migration runner executes the exact official files:

```sql
ALTER TABLE usage_logs
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS session_id VARCHAR(255);
ALTER TABLE batch_image_jobs
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS session_id VARCHAR(255);

ALTER TABLE usage_logs
  DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS usage_logs_request_type_check;
ALTER TABLE usage_logs
  ADD CONSTRAINT usage_logs_request_type_check
  CHECK (request_type >= 0 AND request_type <= 5);

ALTER TABLE groups
  ADD COLUMN allow_live BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false;

CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS idx_users_email_dot_stripped
  ON users ((REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), '.', '')) text_pattern_ops)
  WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
```

The final `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` statement must not be placed inside an
explicit transaction.

### Backup and rollback review

- Before deployment, retain a PostgreSQL backup, the current
  `schema_migrations` rows, the current image/Release digest, and the runtime
  checksum.
- Preferred program rollback leaves these additive database changes in place.
  The v0.1.164 binary ignores the extra columns and index; Live rows may display
  as an unknown request type but remain readable.
- A destructive database rollback is not automatic. It requires maintenance
  mode and a verified backup. Live request rows must first be handled before
  restoring the old `0–4` constraint; dropping the session columns discards
  newly captured correlation data.
- Local database-copy rehearsal was not run because Docker is unavailable on
  this Windows host. The required Linux integration suite and exact-revision
  trusted upgrade gate remain blocking remote checks.

## Regression-risk review

- Order/payment/recharge and custom payment-channel routing are not changed by
  the official backend delta. The merged settings page retains simultaneous
  EasyPay and official-channel enablement plus channel-specific fee/name
  persistence.
- Custom `cyber_policy` scope isolation remains in the thin gateway bridge.
  Official session-ID capture occurs before asynchronous usage recording and
  does not bypass the custom moderation decision.
- API-key bulk actions and updater sources are unchanged. Their mapped
  dashboard/settings sources only receive new official labels and controls.
- New Live scheduling is disabled per group by default, so existing groups do
  not opt in during migration.

### Inherited and platform-specific local results

- `go test -tags=unit ./...` and `go test -tags=integration ./...` each fail
  only
  `TestContentModerationRuntimeSnapshotRefreshFailureKeepsStaleConfig`.
  The official test uses a `1ns` cache TTL and assumes the second call crosses
  a clock tick; Windows can return the same timestamp. The runtime-cache
  methods and this test are unchanged from the official target. Three isolated
  Windows repetitions reproduced the same result. All remaining packages
  pass when this one test is skipped; the exact Linux CI suites remain
  blocking.
- The optional full frontend Vitest run reports 10 unhandled rejections from
  `GroupsView.columnSettings.spec.ts` and `GroupsView.duplicate.spec.ts`
  because their official `adminAPI.groups` mocks do not define the newly used
  `getLiveCapability` method. Their 10 assertions pass, and the component plus
  both tests are Blob-identical to official `v0.1.165`. Repository-required
  critical and custom Vitest suites pass, so the official fixture defect was
  recorded rather than patched.
- `go generate ./ent` could not complete on this Windows worktree because the
  generator hit a file-mapping lock while replacing generated files. All
  partial outputs and the incidental `go.sum` change were restored. The
  committed `backend/ent` tree is Blob-identical to official `v0.1.165`;
  regeneration is deferred to a Linux environment.
- `docker-entrypoint-runtime-test.sh` builds PE executables with the Windows
  Go host and therefore correctly rejects them where the test requires ELF.
  WSL and Docker are unavailable, so the Ubuntu runner must execute this test.
- `apple-container-test.sh` requires macOS `stat -f` behavior and is deferred
  to the repository's macOS runner.
- Local `jq` and `actionlint` are unavailable. Static Release/supply-chain
  checks passed; manifest-fixture and Actions semantic checks are deferred to
  the checksum-pinned Linux CI tools.
- No database-copy rehearsal ran because Docker is unavailable. No production
  database or production server was accessed or modified.
